paragraphs.text: Residents’ parking permits must be renewed every twelve months. About six weeks before your permit expires, the council will send you a reminder letter with a renewal code.

To renew, log in to the council website and enter the renewal code. You will be asked to upload a copy of your vehicle registration document and proof that you still live at the same address, such as a recent utility bill.
Once your documents have been checked, you will receive an email asking you to pay. The fee for one vehicle is £60 a year. Payment can only be made by card.
After payment, your new permit will be posted to you within ten working days. You do not need to return your old permit, but you should destroy it once the new one arrives.
If you change your car during the year, you can transfer your permit to the new vehicle online. There is no charge for this, but you will need to upload the new registration document.
